lines: 你们当为贫寒的人和孤儿伸冤；当为困苦和穷乏的人施行公义。
当保护贫寒和穷乏的人，救他们脱离恶人的手。
Give ear to the cause of the poor and the children without fathers; let those who are troubled and in need have their rights.
Be the saviour of the poor and those who have nothing: take them out of the hand of the evil-doers.
我必不背弃我的约，
也不改变我口中所出的。
I will be true to my agreement; the things which have gone out of my lips will not be changed.
求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，
好叫我们得着智慧的心。
So give us knowledge of the number of our days
that we may get a heart of wisdom.
脚好像在炉中锻炼光明的铜；
声音如同众水的声音。
And his feet like polished brass
as if it had been burned in a fire; and his voice was as the sound of great waters.
我又看见另有一位大力的天使从天降下，
披着云彩，头上有虹，
脸面像日头，两脚像火柱。
And I saw another strong angel coming down out of heaven
clothed with a cloud; and an arch of coloured light was round his head
and his face was like the sun
and his feet like pillars of fire;
弟兄胜过牠，是因羔羊的血和自己所见证的道。他们虽至于死，
也不爱惜性命。
And they overcame him through the blood of the Lamb and the word of their witness; and loving not their lives they freely gave themselves up to death.
看那坐着的，好像碧玉和红宝石；
又有虹围着宝座，
好像绿宝石。
And to my eyes he was like a jasper and a sardius stone: and there was an arch of light round the high seat
like an emerald.
此后，我观看，见有许多的人，
没有人能数过来，
是从各国、各族、各民、各方来的，
站在宝座和羔羊面前，
身穿白衣，手拿棕树枝，
After these things I saw a great army of people more than might be numbered
out of every nation and of all tribes and peoples and languages
taking their places before the high seat and before the Lamb
dressed in white robes
and with branches in their hands
你若口里认耶稣为主，
心里信神叫他从死里复活，
就必得救。
Because
if you say with your mouth that Jesus is Lord
and have faith in your heart that God has made him come back from the dead
you will have salvation:
你们纳粮，也为这个缘故；因他们是神的差役，常常特管这事。
凡人所当得的，就给他。当得粮的，给他纳粮；当得税的，给他上税；当惧怕的，惧怕他；当恭敬的，恭敬他。
For the same reason, make payment of taxes; because the authority is God's servant, to take care of such things at all times.
Give to all what is their right: taxes to him whose they are, payment to him whose right it is, fear to whom fear, honour to whom honour is to be given.
凡人所当得的，
就给他。当得粮的，
给他纳粮；当得税的，
给他上税；当惧怕的，
惧怕他；当恭敬的，
恭敬他。
Give to all what is their right: taxes to him whose they are
payment to him whose right it is
fear to whom fear
honour to whom honour is to be given.
凡人所当得的，就给他。当得粮的，给他纳粮；当得税的，给他上税；当惧怕的，惧怕他；当恭敬的，恭敬他。
凡事都不可亏欠人，惟有彼此相爱，要常以为亏欠；因为爱人的，就完全了律法。
Give to all what is their right: taxes to him whose they are, payment to him whose right it is, fear to whom fear, honour to whom honour is to be given.
Be in debt for nothing, but to have love for one another: for he who has love for his neighbour has kept all the law.
凡事都不可亏欠人，
惟有彼此相爱，
要常以为亏欠；
因为爱人的，就完全了律法。
Be in debt for nothing
but to have love for one another: for he who has love for his neighbour has kept all the law.
赐平安的神快要将撒但践踏在你们脚下。愿我主耶稣基督的恩常和你们同在！
And the God of peace will be crushing Satan under your feet before long. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
作工的得工价，
不算恩典，乃是该得的；
Now
the reward is credited to him who does works
not as of grace but as a debt.
我也知道在我里头，
就是我肉体之中，
没有良善。因为，
立志为善由得我，
只是行出来由不得我。
For I am conscious that in me
that is
in my flesh
there is nothing good: I have the mind but not the power to do what is right.
如今，那些在基督耶稣里的就不定罪了。
因为赐生命圣灵的律，在基督耶稣里释放了我，使我脱离罪和死的律了。
For this cause those who are in Christ Jesus will not be judged as sinners.
For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has made me free from the law of sin and death.
我们知道一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，
直到如今。
For we are conscious that all living things are weeping and sorrowing in pain together till now.
耶路撒冷的众女子啊，我虽然黑，却是秀美，如同基达的帐棚，好像所罗门的幔子。
不要因日头把我晒黑了就轻看我。我同母的弟兄向我发怒，他们使我看守葡萄园；我自己的葡萄园却没有看守。
I am dark, but fair of form, O daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.

Let not your eyes be turned on me, because I am dark, because I was looked on by the sun; my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vine-gardens; but my vine-garden I have not kept.
［新娘］我是沙仑的玫瑰花〔或作：水仙花〕，
是谷中的百合花。
I am a rose of Sharon
a flower of the valleys.
